column1: # The single source of truth for the cmd+k menu.
# bin/menu.sh renders this as a tmux display-menu, and `cmd+k /` fuzzy
# searches the same file. Defining it twice would let the menu and the search
# drift apart, so neither is written by hand in tmux.conf.

column3: tmux command      ("-" alone on a line draws a separator)

column2: find action    fuzzy search this menu

column3: display-popup -E -w 90% -h 80% -T ' log: F to follow, q to quit ' '~/.config/tmux/bin/serve.sh logs'

column2: key probe      what bytes does a key send
